assumptions: Group byte spans are multiples of 8 (or zero); a non-multiple span or an end-before-begin group is out of contract.
A missing element field raises ValueError in the model instead of faulting; that guard is model-only.
File offset equals virtual address minus 0x1000 for the spot-byte checks, as in the earlier #115 packets; the mapping is checked against the ELF program headers by verify.py.
caller_base: the scan passes obj + 0x40 as the leaf base at both call sites, so the counters land at obj + 0xfc8, +0xfd0, +0xfd8, +0xfe0, +0xfe8, +0xff0, +0xff8 and +0x1000

leaf.call_site_note: both call sites are inside the scan; the first serves phase 1, the second phase 2; both pass (obj + 0x40, element)

scan.call_site_note: the single call site sits inside the pipeline wrapper at 0x5f88550, recorded site-only; the wrapper itself is not modelled

leaf_updates.base_plus_0xfa0: old value plus element + 0x80 minus element + 0x88, wrapping 64-bit
leaf_updates.base_plus_0xfb0: old value plus element + 0x80 minus element + 0x88, wrapping 64-bit

not_claimed: The virtual chain's link walk, the global tag it compares against, and the virtual method it calls.
Whether the virtual calls mutate the group table or the count; the model takes both as fixed inputs.
The pipeline wrapper 0x5f88550's own control flow beyond the one call site.
Any meaning for the counters beyond the eight updates the leaf performs.

scan_inputs.count: signed 32-bit value at obj + 0x50; the number of 24-byte group entries at obj + 0xad8
scan_inputs.group_entry: first qword = begin pointer of an 8-byte element-pointer array, second qword = end pointer; the third qword is never read
scan_inputs.predicate: oracle 0x5f77190, called as (obj, element), nonzero result means a match; semantics NOT claimed
scan_inputs.virtual_chain: oracle chain walk from obj + 0x1020 with a virtual call on the first tag-mismatching node; internals NOT claimed, only the sentinel comparison below

scan_phases.phase1_exit: the 20th non-sentinel virtual result breaks out of both loops into phase 2 at once; exhausting all groups falls through into phase 2 the same way
scan_phases.phase1_forward: groups in order, elements in order; a predicate-false element is skipped with no accumulator and no virtual call; a match is accumulated, then the virtual chain runs; a sentinel result continues the scan, any other result increments the special count
scan_phases.phase2_entry_gate: phase 2 returns at once when the accumulated base + 0xf98 counter (obj + 0xfd8) is nonzero, and when the count is not positive
scan_phases.phase2_reverse: groups from last to first, elements from last to first; a match is accumulated; after every element step, a nonzero base + 0xf98 counter ends phase 2 entirely; an empty group contributes nothing

leaf.name: leaf
leaf.role: Accumulator leaf: folds one element's five fields into eight counters.

scan.name: scan
scan.role: Two-phase filtered accumulation over the group table.
